verdicts.why: The selected test asserts that publishing `wall_plan` through both interfaces, and reading its latest value, are refused with `invalid_request`/`unknown_artifact_type`; it also shows that `estimate` is accepted with owner `presupro`. It does not establish the complete A22-1 equality that `estimate` is the only declared first-release type, since it checks only `wall_plan` as an undeclared counterexample.
